dialogue.content: sorted the offcuts into a box. a whole box.
did twenty minutes and called it a session.
showed one person something rough. they were kind about it.
looked up the price of the upgrade again.
took a photo of it and didn't post it.
watched someone much better do it effortlessly.
once something is actually out there I stop revising it. it's fixed, and I go and make the next one instead of circling this one.
then I revise it indefinitely. it's whether it's public, not whether it's finished.
labelled the boxes. all of them.
found a setting I've had wrong for two years.
did the boring maintenance nobody talks about.
moved the whole setup two feet to the left.
kept something private and finished it properly.
started something new before finishing the last thing.
everything I've got better from, I made in the run straight after putting something out. the things I sat on privately I improved endlessly and learned nothing from.
read the manual for something I've used for years.
tried to explain it to someone and heard how odd it sounds.
gave up after ten minutes and made tea instead.
sharpened everything that could be sharpened.
found an old recording I'd forgotten making.
